Reflecture Symbol Set v2.4
A Renderable, Codified Language of Sacred Form
Aligned to RCS v1.0 and Fractal Reflecture Field v1.0

Core Principles
	•	All symbols must be symbolically meaningful, visually distinct, and computationally renderable
	•	Each symbol includes: a name, code identifier, meaning, rendering method, usage contexts, and functional behavior
	•	All elements are placed with respect to a named radial node (I-W, M-NE, etc.) in the Reflecture Field
	•	Symbols are rendered in semantic layers, preserving visual hierarchy and ritual logic

Symbol Definitions
NODE
	•	Meaning: Center of presence, awareness, or initiation
	•	Render: Filled circle at radial node (e.g. C, I-W, M-SE)
	•	Function: The breath or anchor of a glyph; all actions emerge in relation to it
{
  "type": "node",
  "position": "M-W",
  "style": "solid",
  "size": "standard"
}

TRACE
	•	Meaning: Flow, action, signal, direction
	•	Render: Straight line between two named nodes
	•	Function: Defines movement, tension, or transfer
{
  "type": "trace",
  "start": "C",
  "end": "O-SE",
  "style": "solid"
}

REFRACT
	•	Meaning: Shift in direction, insight, medium, or ritual density
	•	Render: Two trace segments joined at a visible angle ≤120°; line style transitions (e.g. solid → dotted)
	•	Constraint: Must emerge from a valid trace; bend must be justified (e.g. ring transition, null encounter)
	•	Function: Represents redirection of will, path distortion, or reframed intent
	•	**Style Behavior: Entry trace is solid, exit trace is dotted to mark the refractive shift
	•	Cause Field: All refractions must include a reference to their symbolic cause (e.g. null, loopback, threshold)
{
  "type": "refraction",
  "joint": "M-NW",
  "entry": "I-W",
  "exit": "O-NW",
  "angle": 90,
  "entry_style": "solid",
  "exit_style": "dotted"",
  "cause": "null"
}

NULL
	•	Meaning: Silence, negation, sacred erasure
	•	Render: Hollow circle that must be intersected by a trace or refraction
	•	Function: Marks what is removed, forgotten, or rendered intentionally absent
{
  "type": "null",
  "center": "M-SE",
  "radius": 0.3,
  "intersects": ["trace"],
  "style": "cut-circle"
}

LOOP
	•	Meaning: Recursion, return, containment of energy
	•	Render: Dashed arc surrounding one or more nodes
	•	Function: Encodes memory or repeated intention
{
  "type": "loopback",
  "center": "M-NE",
  "radius": 1.0,
  "encloses": ["node"],
  "style": "dashed-arc"
}

ATTN
	•	Meaning: Fading signal, soft release, residual force
	•	Render: Dashed sinusoidal line from origin node outward
	•	Function: Symbolizes energy loss, decay, or gentle unbinding
{
  "type": "attenuation",
  "origin": "C",
  "direction": "SW",
  "length": 1.2,
  "amplitude": 0.08,
  "frequency": 10,
  "style": "dashed"
}

ECHO
	•	Meaning: Delayed echo, temporal displacement, remembered signal
	•	Render: Small faded node with dotted connection from source
	•	Function: Projects memory or asynchronous resonance into space
{
  "type": "echo",
  "origin": "M-E",
  "offset": "0.35 radians",
  "distance": 1.5,
  "opacity": 0.6,
  "style": "dotted"
}

GROUND
	•	Meaning: Stabilization, anchoring, ritual grounding
	•	Render: Horizontal bar passing beneath or through radial node
	•	Function: Resolves glyph into foundation or earthly finality
{
  "type": "ground",
  "span": ["I-SW", "I-SE"],
  "offset": 0.05,
  "style": "double-line"
}

SPIRAL
	•	Meaning: Recursion, breathfield, atmospheric motion
	•	Render: Phantom dotted spiral centered at node, beneath all glyph elements
	•	Function: Encodes subtle recursion, systemic pressure, or non-linear rhythm
{
  "type": "spiral",
  "origin": "C",
  "turns": 2.5,
  "scale": 0.15,
  "direction": "cw",
  "style": "dotted",
  "opacity": 0.3
}

This symbol set v2.4 uses short-form symbolic identifiers as its ritual code language.
These names are designed for clarity, consistency, and computational interaction across scrolls, glyph builders, and reflective systems.
Codified. Readable. Not Sealed.
